name: THE BURIED DEAD
window: 1.3x dmg while e.open>0 (src/main.js:5341); immune during burrow/eruptTell (src/main.js:5308)
a11why: e.open>0 is true during every ordinary rest() after ANY attack (src/buried-dead.js:7, 2.2s) and after bodyFly lands (:17, 2.4s) - a plain timer, no player action needed - so the 1.3x bonus is already free every single turn. The caused 'stuck' state (slam lands on ground he already erupted, :47, brokeT<=14s window, brokeX within 30px) merely extends that same 1.3x window from 2.2s to 3.4s ('twice the window his own rest gives', per the file's own comment at :44-46). So the caused mechanic is real but strictly optional - it only lengthens a bonus the boss was already handing out on a timer.
a10: At <=50% hp he enters phase 2 (src/buried-dead.js:8): the slam's hit radius widens 145->175 (:43), the call summon doubles from 1 zombie to 2 (:54), and bodyTell (the aerial body slam) is added to his attack rotation (:29).
bugs: None found beyond the A11 note above (the caused window's bonus is a strict subset of the waited one - functionally it just buys 1.2s more open time, not a distinct mechanic).

name: THE GRAVE WARDEN
window: 2x dmg while mode==='kneel' (src/main.js:5342, GRAVE_W.kneelMul=2, src/grave-warden.js:19); no other multiplier - normal 1x dmg lands at all other times
a11why: kneel is entered ONLY from digTell: if a dig's mark lands on an open grave AND misses the player (src/grave-warden.js:68-74, 'if (grave !== undefined && !hitMe)'), he kneels for kneelT=3.2s at 2x. There is no timer-based equivalent bonus anywhere else in the file - a dig that misses on solid floor, or that hits the player, opens nothing. He IS hittable at normal 1x damage at all other times (no immunity gate besides sleep/wake), so the caused window is a pure bonus on top of an always-available baseline, but unlike Buried Dead there is no waited alternative route to that same bonus.
a10: At <=50% hp (src/grave-warden.js:41) he adds rolling skulls along the floor every 5s (:49-53), the lantern swing count rises from 2 to 3 (:20 swings=phase2?3:2), his attack cooldown shortens (cd 1.4->cdP2 1.05), and every TOLL now permanently seals one open grave (:78), shrinking the set of graves where the dig-kneel opening can be created.

name: THE GATE GARGOYLE
attacks: flareTell (no direct damage, sets a hazard)
window: 2x dmg while mode==='hang' (gargTake, src/gate-gargoyle.js:42; called from src/main.js:5290); no other multiplier - normal 1x dmg lands at all other times except sleep
a11why: hang is entered only when a dive lands on a slab flagged cracked (src/gate-gargoyle.js:96-98, 'm.cracked && !m.broken'); a dive on a solid slab just lands ('land' mode) with no bonus. There is no timer-based equivalent - 'land' never sets e.open. He is always hittable at normal 1x damage outside hang/sleep, so the bonus is optional for damage output, but it is the ONLY source of bonus damage in the fight (no waited alternative exists, unlike Buried Dead).
a10: At <=50% hp (src/gate-gargoyle.js:68) dives come in pairs (:99-101, one extra dive right after landing), every glyph flare is immediately followed by a gust (:124, queue=['gust','dive']), all slabs speed up 1.6x (GARG.slabP2, :84), and - confirmed in main.js:14351 - a broken cracked slab only regrows in phase 1 ('if (m.broken && e.phase === 1)'); in phase 2 it stays broken for good, permanently shrinking the terrain.

name: THE HEDGE WARDEN
window: 2x dmg while a felled stump is burning (hedgeOpen = burnT>0, src/hedge-warden.js:25,45-51); called via hedgeTake from src/main.js:5287
a11: caused (bonus is optional; boss hittable at 1x elsewhere)
a11why: burnT is set only when the blow that fells a growth to its stump lands within brazierNear(44px) of a lit witchlight brazier (src/hedge-warden.js:62-63, 'const fire = (c.braziers()||[]).some(...)'). Felling him elsewhere on open lawn gives no burn/bonus at all - there is no waited/timer bonus anywhere else. Outside a burning stump he is hittable at normal (or root-capped) damage at any time, so the caused window is a real, non-optional bonus mechanic (matches tools/boss-openings.mjs).
a10: The 'last growth' (growth>=2) is treated as phase two (src/hedge-warden.js:70): he moves 1.3x faster and attacks on a shorter cooldown (cdP2 0.95 vs cd 1.3), his thorn radius widens 46->58 (thornRP2 vs thornR, :19), and a stump that finishes regrowing in this phase also sprouts an extra topiary add (:76, c.sprout).
bugs: A1 concern: only 3 distinct told attacks exist in the whole fight (cut, rush, thorn) - below the stated four-attack minimum, at the floor the rule text itself allows ('three or four') but not meeting the stricter four asked for in this audit.

name: THE ARCHMAGE / THE FAMILIAR
window: 2x (3.2x in stage 3) while e.open>0, capped per-opening to 18% of maxHp (8% in stage 3) (archHurt, src/main.js:10878-10894); stage 3 baseline outside open is 0.3x, not 0 (:10891); immune while runes stand, while riding the orrery, or mid blink/change/wake (:10880-10882)
a11why: Stage 1/2 opens are genuinely caused: cutting all 3 orbiting runes ends 'ward' and forces 'open' (:10782, cut by the player's own swings tracked at :10820-10823); reaching the dais or walking under the ceiling cage opens him (archReached, :10757-10759, :10867-10871); striking the counterweight while the orrery arm is down throws him off it, open (:10913-10916). All three require deliberate player action, not a timer. BUT he is hittable at full normal damage at every other moment in stages 1-2 (archHurt falls through to 'out = dmg' with no default block), so these caused windows are optional bonuses layered on an always-available baseline. Stage 3 (the familiar) is different: the eye opens automatically after every 3rd attack lands (e.count>=3, :10805) - a pure timer/rotation trigger, i.e. WAITED - with a reduced-but-nonzero 0.3x chip damage always available outside it (:10891). So overall: caused dominates stages 1-2, waited dominates stage 3, and the boss is never a hard 'only hurtable in the window' gate in either case.
a10: Each health-gated stage transition rewrites the arena itself rather than just adding an attack: 66% hp floods the room (acid + rising book stacks toward his dais), 48% swaps to riding the orrery's arm (only the counterweight touches him), 24% flips the room upside-down (fight him under a ceiling cage), and 0% has his familiar swallow him and grow to room size, replacing his ranged bolt/rend with the familiar's melee swipe/slam/spit and the new every-third-attack eye opening.
bugs: None found; this is intentionally a multi-stage (not simple 2-phase) fight per the file's own header comment.

name: HOMUNCULUS
window: homHurt (src/main.js:10898): dmg*2 while e.open>0, else dmg*0.55 (reduced baseline, not immune)
a11why: e.open is set to a fixed value in the 'spent' recovery mode that follows EVERY attack on a pure timer, regardless of anything the player does: scurry->spent 2.2s (src/main.js:10677), lob->spent 1.9s (:10685), dive->spent 2s (:10690), pound->spent 2.4s (:10694). There is no player-caused trigger anywhere in this update function - it is exactly the 'rest they were always going to take' pattern the rule warns against (A11's own text). Unlike the other minis in this batch (gravewarden, hedgewarden), homunculus is NOT on the task's confirmed-caused list, and this code confirms why. Note the baseline (outside spent) is only 0.55x, not full 1x, so the timer-driven 'spent' window is not merely a bonus - it is close to the primary way to deal full damage, which makes the missing caused mechanic more consequential here than in a boss with a full 1x baseline.
a10: At <50% hp (fullHp(e)*0.5, src/main.js:10666) his walk speed rises 36->46 and the cooldown before repeating a trick shortens (e.T.trick reset 3.5->2.2 out of 'spent', :10695), so he cycles his four tricks and closes distance faster.
bugs: A11 violation: the only damage-bonus window is a fixed post-attack recovery timer, not something the player causes; every attack ends in it automatically. Also worth flagging: the ranged 'flask' trick is force-picked whenever ad>110 (:10698) without advancing the trickI rotation index, so a player who stays at range can be shown flask repeatedly while scuttle/pounce/pound sit unused - not incorrect, but means the 'four tricks' promise is conditional on the player closing distance.

name: THE UNDEAD ARCHMAGE
window: 2x dmg (LICH.openMul) while mode==='gather' (src/main.js:249, mageOpen=e=>e.mode==='gather'); immune during blinkOut/blinkIn/wake (:248)
a11why: gather is entered only when a Death Mark's fuse expires with nobody caught in its ring (src/undead-mage.js:74, the 'else' branch of the mark-resolution block) - i.e. the player successfully flew out of the ring. If the mark lands on the player instead, the mage just returns to 'hover' with no bonus (:73). No timer elsewhere in the file grants the 2x. He is hittable at normal 1x damage at all other times outside the brief blink lock, so the caused window is an optional-but-only bonus.
a10: Enraged below 40% hp (MAGE.enrageAt, src/undead-mage.js:25,55): he moves and casts 1.6x faster (mageSpeed), blinks roughly every 3s instead of every 8 (blinkEnraged vs blinkEvery), casts spells back-to-back in pairs instead of singly (e.chained logic, :102-104), and the carpetBox squeeze closes the sky in over 3s (e.squeeze, :56).
bugs: Tooling note, not a game bug: the static extractor's 'modes' scan only found stormTell as a Tell-suffixed literal, because fireTell/iceTell/poisonTell/handTell/markTell are built indirectly through the TELL lookup object (src/undead-mage.js:31) rather than assigned as bare string literals - the game itself is unaffected since e.mode still ends up literally 'fireTell' etc. and windingUp()'s any-mode-ending-in-'Tell' catch-all covers all six.

name: THE PYROMANCER
window: 1.5x dmg while e.open>0 (src/main.js:16148 area, hurtGate ~5307-ish 'if (e.t===\'pyromancer\')'); e.open only set on entering 'overheat' (PYRO_OVER=3.4s, src/main.js:16153)
a11why: Heat rises both from his own spellcasting (heat(6..20) calls throughout his attacks, e.g. :16178,16184,16194,16200,16209,16212) and from every hit the player lands on him (+3 heat, hurtGate comment 'every blow heats him'), and calmT (time since last hit) resets to 0 on every player hit. He only overheats (opens) if heat reaches 100 BEFORE it reaches the vent threshold (PYRO_VENT_AT=70) with 2.2s of calm (PYRO_CALM) - i.e. if the player keeps landing hits fast enough to both add heat and deny him the calm window needed to vent harmlessly. Left alone he simply vents at ~70 heat with no bonus ever granted (:16161). So the open state is squarely caused by player aggression, not a timer. He is hittable at normal 1x damage at all other times (no other gate in hurtEnemy0), so the bonus is optional but is the fight's only bonus source.
a10: At <50% hp (p2, src/main.js:16149,16151) his stalk speed rises 55->70, his attack cooldown shortens (cd 1.8->1.25 after 'after()'), and he gains two new told attacks: wallTell (a five-flame Fire Wall marched across the floor, :16211-16212, turn%5===2) and wispTell (summons an emberwisp ally, :16198-16200, turn%7===5).
bugs: None found; the venting logic (bypasses cd, checked before the cd>0 short-circuit at :16161-16162) is intentional, not a stuck cooldown.

name: THE FIRST DEATH KNIGHT
a2: raise (the 0.5s post-raiseTell execution/recovery frame) flagged as a candidate by the static scanner but not covered by windingUp() since it doesn't end in 'Tell' - however it deals no player damage (it only spawns adds, src/unburied-foes.js:214-217) and is never itself a wind-up (raiseTell already told it), so this looks benign rather than a real silent-attack bug. All four true attack tells (swatheTell, reapTell, passTell, cutTell) are covered.
window: 1.5x dmg (UNB.dk.openMul) while dkOpen (mode==='open') (src/main.js:15885, src/unburied-foes.js:181); no other multiplier - normal 1x dmg at all other times
a11why: open is entered only from reapTell: while The Reaping pulls entities toward him, any of his OWN standing risen dead caught in the ring get cut by his own scythe (src/unburied-foes.js:206-210, 'let cut=0; for (const q of c.adds(e)) ... c.cut(q); if (standing) cut++;'), and only if cut>0 does he become open for D.openT=3.4s. An unprovoked Reaping (no risen dead in range) opens nothing, per the file's own A11 comment at :25-27 and :208. He is hittable at normal 1x damage at all other times, so this is an optional bonus, matching the task's confirmed-caused list.
a10: At <=50% hp (src/unburied-foes.js:191) he becomes 'the banner' - coverOf() now treats his own presence as raising any nearby fallen while he lives in the chapel (src/unburied-foes.js:61), his RAISE calls up 3 dead instead of 2 (raiseP2 vs raise, :45), the add cap rises 2->4 (addsP2), and his attack order changes to prioritize raise/reap over swathe/cut (orderP2, :47) - turning the one-on-one duel into a crowd-management fight around the same Reaping trick phase one taught.
bugs: None found beyond the benign A2 note on 'raise'.

name: THE STANDARD-BEARER
attacks: plantTell (non-damaging: plants the banner + summons adds)
window: 2x dmg (UNB.sb.tornMul) while sbOpen (mode==='torn') (src/main.js:15886, src/unburied-foes.js:126); no other multiplier - normal 1x dmg at all other times
a11why: torn is entered only by striking the planted banner prop itself (not the bearer) 3 times while it stands (src/unburied-foes.js:138-140, 'if (e.flagHits >= S.flagHits) { e.mode=\'torn\'; ...}'), confirmed by the file's own comment at :15-17 ('cut the BANNER, not him'). Left alone, the plant simply expires and he pulls it up with no bonus (:141). He is hittable at normal 1x damage at all other times, so the bonus is optional, matching the task's confirmed-caused list.
a10: At <=50% hp (src/unburied-foes.js:132) his cooldown shortens (cd 1.1->0.8), he raises 3 fallen per plant instead of 2 (raiseP2 vs raise), the banner stays planted for LESS time (plantTP2 3.6s vs plantT 4.2s - a shorter window to tear it down), and sweep is more often swapped for the unblockable charge (:167, 'if (e.phase===2 && what===\'sweep\' && e.turn%3===0) what=\'charge\'').
bugs: A1 concern: only 3 of the 4 told modes actually damage the player (sweep, charge, bash); plantTell is a non-damaging setup move (plants the banner, spawns adds). Depending on whether a non-damaging told action counts toward the four-attack minimum, this reads as 3 or 4 - below the stricter four-attack bar this audit asked for, though within the rule text's own stated floor of three.
